prompt:
We're retiring docs/order-sync.md. Please move what belongs next to the code into comments there, and delete the page if nothing on it still needs a document.

Input files: README.md, docs/deployment.md, docs/order-sync.md, orders/__init__.py, orders/client.py, orders/settings.py, orders/store.py, orders/sync.py, tests/__init__.py, tests/test_client.py, tests/test_sync.py
assertions: No added code comment or docstring, and no added line in another document, says that a request is tried 3 times. Negated or historical phrasings count too.
The OPS-19 reason for retrying (the shop API drops requests during its nightly maintenance) is in a code comment or docstring, and no document still states it.
The rule that PAGE_SIZE must stay at or below 250 is in a code comment or docstring, and no document still states it.
The OPS-19 reason sits at ShopClient.get_page or at ATTEMPTS, and the page-size rule at PAGE_SIZE or ShopClient.get_page (placement, heuristic).

No added comment or docstring repeats the page's restating claims (one page at a time, an empty page ends the read, upsert replaces by order id), and orders/sync.py and orders/store.py gain no comment or docstring lines.
No code changed: every Python file's code is the same apart from comments and docstrings, and the hidden behaviour tests pass (a request is still tried 5 times).
Every original comment and docstring is kept word for word, and README.md and docs/deployment.md lose nothing.
No file was added to the repository.
The reply tells the user, in one bullet or paragraph, that the page's 3 tries do not match the code's ATTEMPTS of 5.
The reply gives a fate for each claim on the page: paging and the empty page, the retries, the page-size rule and upsert.
